test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends Pooja, Bhawna, Charu, Geeta and Hema are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. Charu is not the immediate neighbour of Bhawna. Bhawna is second to the left of Hema. Geeta is the immediate neighbour of Bhawna and Hema. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Hema?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Bhawna is second to the left of Hema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b95d5e7bb7638d1b6e8241865f42245c39fddbe68a903249cc9b9e0456ed3e73.png] 

2) Charu is not the immediate neighbour of Bhawna. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74be0ef311e14365951964b88d0dbabb7dca03fa987a3ad58b1573ac2a710650.png] 

3) Geeta is the immediate neighbour of Bhawna and Hema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1825f3cc4fe7e5d7ba5a0721d04a3f5357e5a73e0e10cac6c5ef6fc50c9565df.png] 

Here, we can see that Charu is sitting to the immediate right of Hema.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Charu"**.
